brief: Two separate groups of three bases each, bolted together inside each group, with the groups joined to each other only by side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two separate groups of three bases each
requirements.evidence: check_build groups: [0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1] and [0,2 / 1,2 / 0,3] — two groups of three full bases (6 piece parts).

requirements.requirement: Bases bolted together inside each group
requirements.evidence: Six joint bolts placed, one per internal wall: jointBolt refs 0#0,0#0, 0#0,0#5 and 0#0,1#1 in group 1; 0#0,3#1, 0#0,3#2 and 0#0,2#0 in group 2. check_build still warns group 2's bases could slide (LOOSE_BODY), so its bolting is in place per-wall but the configurator does not consider that group fully locked.

requirements.requirement: Groups joined to each other only by side connectors
requirements.evidence: The single shared wall between the groups (0,1|0,2) carries connector:0#0,1|0,2 (side-connector-single) and no joint bolt; get_build topology lists that wall as 'connector' and all other touching walls as internal to a group.

finish.summary: Built two triangular clusters of three full bases each, touching at exactly one wall. That shared wall carries a single side connector joining the groups; each internal wall carries a joint bolt. Open faces were capped with solid caps. check_build is clear of errors and mesh clashes; it still warns the second group could slide despite its per-wall bolts, so that requirement is reported partial.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
